body.cap: Attendees entering CES 2026 Unveiled Las Vegas | Photo - Consumer Technology Association (CTA)®

body.x: The Consumer Technology Association (CTA)®, owner and producer of CES®, announced CES Asia™ Unveiled Seoul, a new event held in partnership with the Korea Electronics Association (KEA) during KES, Oct. 13-16, at the COEX Convention & Exhibition Center in Seoul. Building on Korea's strong participation at CES, the event will connect innovators, exhibitors, startups, investors and media. CES Asia Unveiled Seoul will showcase Korean companies preparing to exhibit at CES, offering a preview of the technologies they will bring to the global stage in Las Vegas.

"Korean innovation is helping shape the technologies, ideas and partnerships driving our industry forward," said Kinsey Fabrizio, President and CEO of CTA. "Korea is a valued part of the CES community, and we're thrilled to partner with KEA as it celebrates its 50th anniversary to bring CES Asia Unveiled to Seoul. Together, we will build momentum toward CES 2027."

CES will participate in KES programming through a keynote conversation with Fabrizio and a presentation on the technology trends shaping CES 2027. The sessions will spotlight Korea's growing influence across AI, mobility, digital health and consumer technology, underscoring the country's continued engagement with CES and its expanding role in shaping the future of global innovation.

Korea stands as one of CES's strongest international markets. More than 13,000 attendees traveled from Korea to CES 2026, reflecting the depth of the country's engagement with the show. At CES 2026, KEA exhibited on the show floor and played a central role in connecting Korean innovators with global customers, partners, investors and media. That footprint reflects Korea's broader technology strength: The country leads in consumer electronics, mobility, semiconductors, AI and digital health, and is home to some of the world's most influential technology companies alongside a thriving startup ecosystem — a combination that has made Korea a consistent source of innovation showcased each year at CES.

"KEA works closely with companies across Korea's technology sector to advance innovation and accelerate global growth," said Jaeyoung Park, CEO and President of KEA. "CES Asia Unveiled Seoul creates a new opportunity to strengthen connections across Korea's technology ecosystem, spotlight the country's dynamic innovation and build momentum toward CES 2027 as Korea continues to stand out on the global technology stage."

As part of CTA's engagement across Asia this October, CTA leaders will also participate in CES Asia Unveiled Hong Kong, connecting with innovators, business leaders and media from across the region ahead of CES 2027. CES 2027, where global business gets done, takes place Jan. 6-9, 2027, in Las Vegas.

As North America's largest technology trade association, CTA is the tech sector. Our members are the world's leading innovators — from startups to global brands — helping support more than 17 million American jobs. CTA owns and produces CES®, the world's most powerful tech event. Find us at CTA.tech. Follow us @CTAtech.

The Korea Electronics Association (KEA), established in 1976, is Korea's leading industry association representing the electronics and IT sectors. KEA supports the growth and global competitiveness of Korea's technology industry by promoting innovation, AI transformation, global business, and industry cooperation. Learn more at the KEA official website.

KES is Korea's leading technology exhibition and a platform for showcasing innovation and connecting companies, industry leaders and global partners. Celebrating its 57th edition in 2026, KES has grown alongside Korea's technology industry as a platform for innovation, business and global collaboration. KES 2026, under the theme "AI in Motion," takes place Oct. 13-16 at COEX in Seoul. Learn more at the KES official website.
